# Analysis

This is a starter Quarto analysis document for the course.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Example data summary
mtcars |>
  group_by(cyl) |>
  summarize(
    avg_mpg = mean(mpg, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Visualization

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel economy vs. weight",
    x = "Weight",
    y = "MPG",
    color = "Cylinders"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
